newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SKI JUMPING-GOLDBERGER'S FUTURE TO BE DECIDED ON MONDAY.
newsitem.headline: SKI JUMPING-GOLDBERGER'S FUTURE TO BE DECIDED ON MONDAY.

text.p: The Austrian ski federation (OSV) said it would decide on Monday what action to take against ski jumper Andreas Goldberger who has admitted to using cocaine.
Goldberger, 25, overall World Cup ski jumping and ski flying champion in 1995 and 1996, told Austrian television ORF on Sunday that he took the drug at a Vienna disco a year ago.
Goldberger dismissed accusations he had regularly bought, sold and consumed large amounts of the drug. He said police had questioned him and searched his house but that no evidence had been found.
"I was curious and I tried it once. It was a big mistake," Goldberger said.
OSV president Peter Schroecksnadel told the Austrian news agency APA on Monday the federation had temporarily suspended Goldberger until a disciplinary board meeting.
An OSV spokeswoman said the disciplinary board would meet on Monday afternoon to discuss the case.
